name: Mag Mucramhan

attributes.attribute: an Irish mythological site also called Mag Mucrama
the reputed site of a great battle near Athenry in County Galway
the king of Munster who fought the battle of Mag Mucramhan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mag Mucramhan was an Irish mythological site, also called Mag Mucrama. A field near the castle town of Athenry in County Galway is the reputed site of a great battle. The rulers were Ailill Olom, king of the province of Munster, and his enemy and foster son, Lugaidh mac Conn.

okr.objective: Document Mag Mucramhan as the reputed site of a great Irish battle near Athenry.
key_results: Record the variant name Mag Mucrama.
Record the location near Athenry in County Galway.
Record the combatants Ailill Olom and Lugaidh mac Conn.
